title: Use timezone-aware datetimes for staleness and API cutoffs
description: scheduler.py:140/:196 and api_routes.py:56/:77 use naive datetime.now()/fromtimestamp; local-time DST transitions can distort cutoffs and mtime staleness math. Adopt consistent timezone-aware now (UTC or local with tz) across scheduler staleness, ingestion timestamps, and API period cutoffs; keep DB semantics compatible.
close_reason: should_run_job now uses absolute epoch arithmetic (time.time() - getmtime) instead of naive datetime subtraction, eliminating the DST-distortion failure mode; storage/API sides documented as a shared local-naive convention (scheduler job timestamp = mtime; API cutoffs match). Full tz-aware UTC storage was evaluated and rejected: SQLite DateTime columns drop tzinfo on round-trip, so it would require migrating every existing DB row for no practical benefit in a single-operator tool — recorded in code comments at both sites. 46 passed; ruff/mypy/bandit clean.

title: Type-annotate public functions across web_app and scoring script
description: Route handlers, ingest_data, job, run_playbook, parse_inventory, build_subscore_figure, generate_benchmark_charts lack return annotations; raw_data/overall_data/host_to_ip params untyped (scheduler.py:87). Annotate without loosening mypy config.
close_reason: Annotated all previously untyped public functions: scheduler (parse_inventory, load_combined_results, ingest_data, run_playbook, job, run_job_safely, should_run_job, start_scheduler) — with an explicit loud RuntimeError fallback for the impossible stdout=None Popen case instead of silent skips; api_routes (4 handlers typed to their FastAPI response-model contracts via cast over the ORM rows); chart (build_subscore_figure, generate_benchmark_charts); scoring script (parse_combined_results, calculate_overall_performance with a behavior-identical restructure binding custom weights to a non-optional Mapping so the type checker follows the validate-once flow). No mypy config loosening. 49 passed; ruff/mypy/bandit clean.

title: Cover main.py lifespan, run_playbook subprocess, and start_scheduler loop with tests
description: Coverage: chart/api_routes/data_models 100% branch, scheduler.py 87%, main.py 0%. No test boots the real web_app.app.main.app; run_playbook subprocess execution and start_scheduler polling loop untested. Add: real-app boot test via lifespan (asserts init_db + scheduler thread start, then clean shutdown), run_playbook test with a stub ansible-playbook on PATH (verify argv, output draining, no deadlock), start_scheduler tick test with monkeypatched schedule loop.
close_reason: New tests/test_app_boot.py: (1) real-app lifespan boot via TestClient — asserts init_db ran, dashboard / serves the static page, scheduler thread started (async-safe poll), clean shutdown; (2) run_playbook subprocess via executable stub on PATH — pins argv contract (repo-anchored absolute inventory+playbook from the module's own constants), drains >64KB merged stdout+stderr without deadlock, proves CWD independence; (3) start_scheduler — registers the GUARDED run_job_safely (never bare job()), clamps interval to the 1-minute schedule-library minimum, spawns exactly one polling thread, runs the first tick inline. Coverage: main.py 0%->100%, scheduler.py 87%->95%, total 98%. 49 passed; ruff/mypy/bandit clean.

title: Isolate per-host ingest failures so one malformed host row cannot lose the batch
description: scheduler.py:100 RawBenchmarkSubscores(**conditions, **scores) raises on unexpected keys from malformed playbook JSON; run_job_safely catches but the ENTIRE ingest batch is lost. Wrap per-host construction so good hosts still land; log the rejected host with its keys.
close_reason: ingest_data now validates each host before mutation: non-dict or unrecognized-key raw subscores skip that host only (logged with offending keys); non-numeric/bool overall score drops only that overall row while raw still lands; single commit per run unchanged. Environmental DB errors still fail loudly by design. Regression tests: test_ingest_data_isolates_malformed_host, test_ingest_data_skips_only_non_numeric_overall_score. 46 passed; ruff/mypy/bandit clean.

title: Anchor runtime paths to repo root (logs, SQLite, inventory parse in job())
description: logger_config.py writes cloud_benchmarker.log/old_logs relative to process CWD (systemd launch from / loses logs); default sqlite:///cloud_benchmarker.sqlite resolves against CWD; job() passes raw relative ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_FILE_PATH to parse_inventory (scheduler.py:146) while run_playbook uses the anchored absolute path (scheduler.py:118) — non-repo CWD breaks inventory parsing. Extend the existing repo-root anchoring doctrine (_REPO_ROOT pattern from scheduler.py:25-30).
close_reason: Anchored all runtime paths to repo root: job() now passes ANSIBLE_INVENTORY_ABSOLUTE_PATH to parse_inventory (was raw relative decouple value); logger_config exposes repo-root LOG_FILE_PATH/OLD_LOGS_DIR; init_db rewrites relative sqlite:/// URLs via _repo_anchored_sqlite_url (absolute/:memory:/file: URI/non-sqlite untouched, query preserved). Regression tests: test_log_paths_are_repo_anchored, test_repo_anchored_sqlite_url_variants, test_job_parses_inventory_via_repo_anchored_absolute_path; logger namer/rotator tests reworked for anchored dirs. Smoke-proved from /tmp: DB URL and log path resolve to repo root. 44 passed; ruff/mypy/bandit clean.
